meta.title: xSim client portal
meta.label: Client portal
meta.noscript: The client portal needs JavaScript. Please turn it on, or write to hello@xsim.dev.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: The xSim client portal is for invited participants and the xSim team.
login.waitCheck: Please wait for the security check to finish, then try again.
login.help: Forgot your password or lost your authenticator? Write to hello@xsim.dev and we will send you a new setup link.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

setup.title: Welcome, {name}
setup.intro: Choose a password for {email}. Next you will set up two-factor authentication.
setup.introReset: Your password for {email} was reset by an administrator. Choose a new one, then set up two-factor authentication again.
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easier to remember than a code.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setup.invalid: Setup links work once and expire after a few days. Ask xSim for a new link at hello@xsim.dev.

twofa.title: Set up two-factor authentication
twofa.intro: Each time you sign in, you will enter a code from an app on your phone as well as your password.
twofa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone if you do not have one, for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
twofa.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this code.
twofa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows for xSim.
twofa.qrAlt: QR code for adding xSim to your authenticator app
twofa.openApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
twofa.manual: Cannot scan? Enter a key instead
twofa.manualHint: Choose to enter a setup key, select a time-based code, and type this key:

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once instead of a code from the app. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They will not be shown again.
recovery.ack: I have saved my recovery codes

home.title: Hello, {name}
home.noneToAnswer: There is nothing for you to answer right now.
home.anonNote: Results are combined across the team. Individual answers and written comments are not shown here.

new.title: New survey
new.titleHint: Optional when you start from a template.
new.needTitle: Give the survey a title in at least one language.
new.companyHintEditor: Only admins can add companies. Ask an admin if the company you need is missing.
new.noCompaniesEditor: There are no customer companies yet. Ask an admin to add one.

edit.locked: People have started answering this survey, so questions, options and scales can no longer be added, removed or restructured. Wording can still be corrected. To make bigger changes, duplicate the survey.
edit.closesHint: After this time answers can no longer be changed. Entered in your computer's time zone.
edit.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 256 KB. Shown next to the xSim logo.

statusHint.draft: Only xSim can see a draft. Open it when the questions and respondents are ready.
statusHint.open: Respondents can answer and change their answers.
statusHint.closed: Answers are final. Results remain available.

edit.confirmOpen: Respondents will see this survey on their home page. Check the preview first. Once someone answers, the structure is locked.
edit.confirmClose: Respondents will no longer be able to change their answers. You can reopen it later.
edit.confirmDelete: This removes the survey and its questions. It cannot be undone.
edit.confirmDeleteAnswers: This survey has answers. Deleting it removes every answer as well. It cannot be undone.
edit.capabilityHint: Scale questions in a section tagged with a capability count toward that capability's current-state score.
edit.confirmDeleteSection: This removes the section and its questions.
edit.gridHint: Each row is rated on the same scale. Tag a row with a capability to use it as that capability's importance score.
edit.allowNa: Offer N/A (not enough exposure to answer)
edit.maxSelectHint: Leave empty to allow any number.
edit.rankLimitHint: Leave empty to rank every option.
edit.unitsHint: The range is split into this many steps.

people.respondentsHint: People at {company} who are asked to answer this survey.
people.ceoHint: Marking the CEO enables the CEO versus team comparison. Only xSim sees it; customer Viewers see whole-team results.
people.confirmRemoveAnswers: {name} has started answering. Removing them deletes their answers.
people.noneLeft: Every respondent at {company} is already on this survey. To add someone new, ask an admin to create their account.
people.noneLeftAdmin: Every respondent at {company} is already on this survey. To add someone new, create their account under Users with the Respondent role.
people.editorsHint: Editors on a survey can change it and see its results. Each editor can delete only the questions they created.
people.creator: (created the survey)

take.previewNote: Preview. Answers given here are not saved.
take.closed: This survey is closed. Your answers are shown for reference.
take.alreadySubmitted: You submitted on {date}. You can still change your answers while the survey is open.
take.naLong: N/A: I do not have enough exposure to answer
take.rankAll: Put the options in order, most important first.
take.rankLimit: Choose your top {n}, most important first.
take.missing: {n} required questions still need an answer. They are marked in the form.
take.autosave: Your answers are saved as you go. You can come back and change them until the survey closes.
take.previewFoot: Submitting is turned off in the preview.
take.thanks: Your answers have been submitted. You can return and change them until the survey closes.

results.hidden: Results appear once at least {n} people have submitted, so that no individual can be identified. Submitted so far: {submitted}.
results.anonNote: Combined results for the whole team, shown after the survey closed and only when at least {n} people submitted. Written answers are summarized by xSim in the report.
results.includePartial: Include answers from people who have not submitted yet
results.capHint: Current state is the mean of the capability's scale items (N/A excluded). Priority gap is importance × (scale maximum − current state), so larger means important and underperforming. Spread is the standard deviation of each person's own average, with the lowest and highest in brackets; a wide spread means people see the capability differently.
results.ceoHint: The CEO's scores against the rest of the team. Rows with a difference of one point or more are highlighted.
results.rankHint: Points: first place earns as many points as there are options, then one fewer per place.
results.individualsHint: Individual answers are confidential and never shown to the customer.
results.individualNote: Confidential. Individual answers are for xSim analysis only and must not be shared with the customer.
results.expandHint: Open a part to see each question's answers.
results.hiddenOpen: Results appear here once the survey closes, so that no one's answers can be worked out by watching the totals change. Submitted so far: {submitted}.

roles.editorHint: Builds surveys and sees their results
roles.viewerHint: Sees anonymized results for their company
roles.respondentHint: Answers surveys they are added to

users.title: Users
users.intro: Everyone with portal access. People cannot sign in until they have used their setup link and turned on two-factor authentication.
users.create: Create user and get setup link
users.createHint: Name, email, phone and company are required.
users.search: Search by name, email or company
users.name: Full name
users.companyHint: Choose an existing company. A new name here also creates the company.
users.langHint: Setup links open the portal in this language.
users.confirmReset: {name}'s password and two-factor authentication will be removed and they will be signed out everywhere. You will get a link to send them so they can set both up again.
users.confirmDisable: {name} will be signed out and will not be able to sign in. Their answers are kept.
users.emailed: A setup link was emailed to {email}.
users.linkManual: Email delivery is not switched on yet. Copy this link and send it to {name} yourself. It works once and expires in {days} days.
users.linkEmailFailed: The email could not be sent. Copy this link and send it to {name} yourself. It works once and expires in {days} days.
users.linkHintSetup: Send it only to {email}. Anyone with the link can set the password for this account.
users.linkHintReset: Send it only to {email}. When they open it they choose a new password and set up two-factor authentication again.
users.staffHint: Admin and Editor can only be given to people in the xSim company. Customers get Respondent and Viewer.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: The latest 200 account and survey events.

audit.admin_bootstrap: Admin created from the command line

account.title: Your account
account.langHint: Used for links sent to you. Switch the portal language with the link at the top.
account.pwChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
account.recoveryHint: Get a new set of recovery codes. The old ones stop working. Enter a current code from your authenticator app to confirm.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.bad_credentials: That email and password do not match.
errors.bad_code: That code is not valid. Check the code and try again.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.verification_failed: The security check failed. Please try again.
errors.turnstile_unavailable: The security check could not load. Check your connection or try another browser.
errors.password_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.password_weak: Choose a password that is harder to guess.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.not_found: Not found, or you do not have access.
errors.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.last_admin: There must always be at least one active admin.
errors.self_demote: You cannot remove your own admin role.
errors.self_disable: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.not_pending: This user has already completed setup. Use Reset password instead.
errors.structure_locked: This survey has answers, so its structure is locked.
errors.not_creator: Only the editor who created it (or an admin) can delete this.
errors.has_answers: This cannot be done because the survey already has answers.
errors.no_questions: Add at least one question before opening the survey.
errors.required_missing: Some required questions still need an answer.
errors.bad_answer: One of the answers is not valid.
errors.too_long: One of the texts is too long.
errors.too_few_items: Add at least two options (or one row).
errors.bad_range: The minimum is larger than the maximum.
errors.logo_too_large: The logo must be 256 KB or smaller.
errors.logo_type: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.too_large: Too much data in one request.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: The portal is not available right now.
errors.company_taken: A company with this name already exists.
errors.company_in_use: This company still has users or surveys.
errors.company_protected: The xSim company cannot be renamed or deleted.
errors.mfa_locked: Too many wrong codes. Sign-in is paused for this account; try again later or write to hello@xsim.dev.
errors.setup_expired: Setup was not finished within 24 hours. Ask xSim for a new setup link at hello@xsim.dev.
errors.staff_roles_internal: Admin and Editor roles are only for members of the xSim company.
errors.no_pending_setup: There is no two-factor setup in progress. Sign in again.
errors.db_outdated: The portal database needs an update. An administrator must run the database migration (npm run db:migrate, or db:migrate:local for the preview).

companies.title: Companies
companies.intro: Customer companies and the xSim team. Add a company first, then its users and surveys. A company can be deleted only while it has no users and no surveys.
companies.name: Company name
companies.nameHint: As it should appear to xSim and on the customer's survey pages.
companies.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? It has no users or surveys.
